name: Dronage Zero
description: PRO TIP: R1+Select is HELP. Dronage Zero is an ambient drone workstation with 4 oscillators, a mod matrix with 8 LFOs and rich effects such as a granular delay and a shimmer reverb. It is the "eye-friendly" version of Dronage Terminal, and the two share one project format: a project saved in either opens in the other. Projects, recordings, themes and user scales are kept in the DronageZero folder at the root of the SD card.
author: boorch (Bruce Menace/Cometary Trails)
features: IMPORTANT: Press R1+Select for the HELP screen
Five views (OSC, LFO, MOD, EFX, VIZ) switched with L4 and R4
8 LFOs, a modulation matrix and a 5-track modulation sequencer
Stereo delay with granular mode, shimmer reverb, tape dirt, compressor
8 scenes per project, undo and redo, random rolls
Full-screen visualizers and an optional CRT look
Scala microtuning, 20 colour themes, WAV recording
